description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M, beats exp684 by 1.5 mb at 28% fewer params). Adds pre_lut (from exp695 spec, v_lut shape: NAP=6, tph=256, n_heads=6, n_out=d_v=24) on top of emb_resid_lut. Both modifications composed: emb_resid_lut writes raw-embedding signal to D-stream (solves 'unembedder needs raw token'), pre_lut transforms E-stream right after embedding (potentially frees L0 attention from per-token-transformation). Goal: see whether L0 attention self_mass drops now that pre_lut handles the per-token transform. Param impact: +2.36M -> ~103M total. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M (emb_resid_lut only), exp695=killed-at-4200 1.5161 (pre_lut only), exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M.
